one_line: White-label CRM and marketing automation platform for agencies, with a REST API for contacts, campaigns, and funnels.
auth_notes: Private/API integration uses an API key from the location/sub-account settings; public apps use OAuth2 with app approval. Docs at developer.leadconnectorhq.com (formerly highlevel.stoplight.io).
self_serve_notes: Requires a paid GoHighLevel subscription (Starter/Unlimited/SaaS plans; 14-day trial available). API key self-serve within an account; OAuth public apps require submitting for review.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Contacts, campaigns, conversations, calendars/appointments, funnels/triggers, opportunities, workflows, emails, SMS; ~100+ endpoints
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for contact, campaign, calendar, conversation and other events

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP; community MCP servers for GoHighLevel exist (unverified).
